connector.name: Knowledge Graph RDBMS
connector.registryDescription: A label property graph on SQLite/Postgres with multi-ontology routing and a gated MCP server.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package knowledge-graph-rdbms. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the cunicopia-dev account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: KGRDBMS_HOME
env.description: Storage root for ontology databases and the event log. Defaults to ~/.kgrdbms.

env.name: KGRDBMS_DEFAULT_ONTOLOGY
env.description: Name of the default ontology used when a tool call omits the `ontology` argument. Defaults to "default".
